en:
Eh? Greetings, young Adventurer. You're a brave one to find your way here with all those wandering creatures about!

Well now that you are here, maybe you can help an old hermit...
Huh?!? Oh. You don't look like a Defias thief...or a member of the Night Watch. Take pity on a poor soul, will ya?
Greetings, adventurer. If you're a friend of Colonel Kurzen then I'll have you cut down where you stand! but if you've come to aid us, then lend an ear...
This is a dangerous place, adventurer. Be careful around here.
You watch where you step around here, son. You might not be a part of our outfit, but that doesn't mean I won't take a cane to you if you fall out of line!
